name: Why I Like Pi Coding Agent: Build the Harness You Actually Need – damian_site
description: The last two posts were about making the terminal my main workplace: tmux, Neovim, lazygit, and a theme I can comfortably look at all day. The other program now permanently open in that setup is Pi, a coding agent I have been using for the last month.
